snippet.title: Guardians - Arcade Longplay (Girulian)
snippet.description:
Title: Guardians
Character: Girulian
Platform: Arcade
Type: Longplay
Developer: WinkySoft
Publisher: Banpresto
Release: 1995
Footage captured by: @GMBLongplays 

Guardians (Arcade) is a fast-paced side-scrolling beat 'em up game released in 1995 by Banpresto. Set in a futuristic world, players take on the role of cyber-enhanced heroes battling against alien forces and rogue machines threatening Earth. With intense action, colorful graphics, and a variety of special moves and weapons, Guardians delivers a classic arcade experience full of explosive combat and cooperative gameplay.

Arcade Longplays - https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLlERJYeRTVpCjwu6eSPGKgnJqAldZQ4Ms
